core_philosophies.intent: Use completed work and real outcomes to make Fractal better at future Projects.

protagonist_mechanisms.intent: Run the original five-step reasoning process after the primary user completes a Project.

methodologies.intent: Review the whole Project history and collect positive and negative observations with high recall.
Separate symptoms from plausible causes and form meaningful local patterns.
Compare current findings with previous analyses, interventions, reversals, and outcomes.
Decide whether to delete, shorten, merge, simplify, reconfigure, modify, or add an agentic element.
Compare before and after evidence to decide whether Fractal genuinely improved.
Treat repeated effort and diminishing return as a reason to investigate a better method.
methodologies.evidence_requirement: Active status requires a live work-completed event, one compact Work Signature, deterministic repetition evaluation, and a tested evidence route into Project Review or System Review.

methodologies.intent: Explore current, adjacent, and structurally related ideas that may improve the work.
methodologies.evidence_requirement: Whenever a solution is needed, execution evidence records the exact 60/20/20 allocation, one honest outcome per route, source provenance, relevance, no automatic adoption, and the Project Review or System Review that received the finding. Improvement Options fails closed when this evidence is absent.

methodologies.intent: After real success, look for a materially better result in quality, time, Tokens, or scope using evidence-backed comparisons.
methodologies.evidence_requirement: Execution evidence preserves the achieved baseline, comparison source, stronger target, representative trial, and original Success Criteria result.

secondary_mechanisms.intent: During a Project, compare the whole Project with its Plan and correct its trajectory when a milestone or exception calls for review.

mechanisms.intent: Use exact programs and rules for work that can be made repeatable, testable, and unambiguous.
In Step 1, maximise recall before Step 2 filters, groups, or explains observations.
In Step 4, consider delete, shorten, merge, simplify, reconfigure, and modify before adding complexity.
Judge a change by the whole Project and system result as well as its direct local effect.
Capture a compact, privacy-bounded record of completed work for repetition and outcome comparison.
Give every Fractal-controlled component a semantic name that passes deterministic checks before activation.
Compare requested work with registered, permitted, non-overlapping, and evidenced capabilities.
Run deterministic handling when a known platform event occurs.
Register, project, verify, quarantine, restore, and remove every discoverable agentic component through Fractal.
For a consequential proposal, compare independently formed Case For and Case Against before the Main Agent decides what to recommend.
Investigate why a problem exists when history or reversal evidence challenges the current causal model.
Test a reversible hypothesis against a preserved baseline and measurable outcome.
Show current state, evidence, decisions, risks, and restore routes in ordinary language.
